verdict.rationale: AFK's docs describe cross-platform querying/acting (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe) from one surface and directed-graph task execution with parallel branches, which implies some multi-item/parallel handling, but there's no explicit mention of bulk operations like batch editing, bulk approvals, or acting on many records at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-action UI/API, evidence of scaling to 'many items' simultaneously, and independent corroboration beyond first-party docs.
